description: BSM2-Python implements IWA BSM1 and BSM2 layouts, with configurable aeration and reporting of influent, effluent and operating-cost indices. The documented default BSM2 run spans 609 simulated days. This resource is provided by fau-evt (repository owner). Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. Access is through the linked repository or provider page; the exact file formats are not fully established. Licence: BSD-3-Clause. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: This is a separate Python implementation of the existing benchmark definitions, not new physical observations. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. The relationship follows the named method or resource; it does not certify file compatibility.
